description: This file defines extension methods for database operations, including parameter creation, data retrieval, and object mapping, specifically for use with ADO.NET in a .NET environment. It provides utility functions for handling database types, parameters, and data records, and is part of the Orleans project with multiple namespace options based on compilation symbols.

classes.name: DbExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for database command and data record operations, including parameter creation, data retrieval, and object mapping.

methods.name: CreateParameter
methods.description: Creates a new IDbDataParameter with specified properties, avoiding boxing for value types.

methods.name: AddParameter
methods.description: Adds a parameter to an IDbCommand with specified name, value, direction, size, and type.

methods.name: GetValueOrDefault
methods.description: Retrieves a value from IDataRecord by field name, returning a default if null or DBNull.

methods.name: GetDateTimeValueOrDefault
methods.description: Retrieves a DateTime? value from IDataRecord by field name, specifying kind as UTC.

methods.name: GetValueAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a value from DbDataReader by field name.

methods.name: ReflectionParameterProvider
methods.description: Uses reflection to add parameters to a command based on properties of a given object.

methods.name: ReflectionSelector
methods.description: Creates an object of a specified type from IDataRecord by mapping properties.
